seeded.note: Candidates seeded from a research agent's web-search summaries (see data/leads); unverified until the contest file cites the Secretary of State certified list. No stance questions set yet. Research notes: Two Democrats advanced from the June 2 primary (Pleasanton Weekly later count: Wahab 36.72%, Hernandez 16.62%, Wendy Huang (R) 14.68%; KTVU and NBC figures differ, NBC page showed zero vote counts). Separate special election for the unexpired term: special primary June 16, special general August 18, 2026; the special was for the existing seat, while the November race uses the Prop 50 map, so boundaries may differ. Wahab marked incumbent because KQED and VoteSee describe her as the U.S. representative/incumbent; Wikipedia lists her as assuming office September 2, 2026, but no primary source (Clerk of the House, bioguide) confirming swearing-in was found. Wahab birth date: JoinCalifornia lists January 11, 1987 and Wikipedia gives 1987/1988, born in New York City; not from a primary source, so not recorded as facts. Wahab doctorate type conflicts (DSW vs Ph.D.). Hernandez Dublin dates: BART bio says eight years on council plus four as mayor; another source says first elected 2016; reconcile. A Ballotpedia list naming Hernandez, Matt Ortega, Abrar Qadir and Wendy Huang for November appears to predate the primary. Ballot designations for both candidates not found.
